items.title: 標普警告稱，英偉達的信用評級可能因管理和治理風險「上升」而被下調。
items.titleEn: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
items.titleZh: 標普警告稱，英偉達的信用評級可能因管理和治理風險「上升」而被下調。
items.summaryEn: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.
items.summaryZh: 標普全球評級表示，由於指出晶片製造商英偉達的管理和治理風險“不斷上升”，其信用評級可能會被下調一級。

items.title: 聯準會首選的通膨指標在10月加速升至3.8%，這可能意味著升息已成定局。
items.titleEn: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge accelerated to 3.8% in October, likely sealing rate hike
items.titleZh: 聯準會首選的通膨指標在10月加速升至3.8%，這可能意味著升息已成定局。
items.summaryEn: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show an annual inflation rate of 3.8% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
items.summaryZh: 根據道瓊共識，10月個人消費支出物價指數預計將顯示年通膨率為3.8%。

items.title: 受英偉達股價下跌影響，股指期貨走低，回吐了周一的部分漲幅：即時更新

items.summaryEn: On Monday, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite posted their best sessions since April 2025 as the artificial intelligence trade roared back to life.
items.summaryZh: 週一，隨著人工智慧交易的強勢回歸，標普500指數和納斯達克綜合指數均創下自2025年4月以來的最佳單日表現。

items.title: 在科技股大幅拋售後，Anthropico和Nvidia的股價在盤前交易中上漲。
items.titleEn: Anthropic, Nvidia shares rise in premarket trading after major tech selloff
items.titleZh: 在科技股大幅拋售後，Anthropico和Nvidia的股價在盤前交易中上漲。
items.summaryEn: The Nasdaq slid 10% last week in its worst week since the early days of Covid in 2020.
items.summaryZh: 那斯達克指數上週下跌 10%，創下自 2020 年新冠疫情初期以來最糟糕的一周表現。

items.title: 技術故障正在助長一種新的末日經濟。
items.titleEn: Tech outages are fueling a new doomsday economy
items.titleZh: 技術故障正在助長一種新的末日經濟。
items.summaryEn: Recent technology outages have left some worried about AI cyberattacks and the U.S. electricity grid. The doomsday economy is heating up as a result.
items.summaryZh: 近期發生的技術故障引發了人們對人工智慧網路攻擊和美國電網的擔憂。由此，末日經濟論調愈演愈烈。

items.summaryEn: The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average closed in correction territory, off 10% from their records. The Nasdaq Composite lost its gain for the year.
items.summaryZh: 標普500指數和道瓊工業指數收盤都進入回檔區間，較歷史高點下跌10%。那斯達克指數也失去了今年以來的所有漲幅。
